name: Teresa Russell
bio: Teresa Russell is a Southern California blues-rock guitarist and singer. She started out playing the Sunset Strip at a young age and has shared stages with Johnny Winter, Walter Trout and Kenny Wayne Shepherd. She was also the only woman in the top eight at the national Guitarmageddon finals.
bio_source: Written by TOPA from teresarussell.com, the Santa Maria Sun and @teresarussellguitar.
